profile.headline: Software Engineer at United States Department of Defense
profile.summary: Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the telecommunications industry. Skilled in Python, Project Management, Analytical Skills, Microsoft Word, Software Documentation, and Leadership. Strong information technology professional with a Master of Science (M.S.) focused in Computer Science from Georgia Institute of Technology.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
	Redesign fixture 4096607-767 for EDM Machine 3231; setup and program Chmer. 
	Find root cause and corrective action for shot peens entering the cavity of 2099M31G03.
	Track the key operations, casting, and inventory of the top delinquent parts in commercial blades

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
	Conducted four design reviews of satellites and towers. 
	Assisted System Engineers with presale and post-sale for satellites and towers.
	Used the software REC to create parts list for satellites and towers.

positions.title: Intern FaST member
positions.description:
	Used the software MATLAB to create statistical model to compare and analyze internet data packages. 
	Gained knowledge by comparing the two different software packages Library Support Vector Machines and Library LINEAR.
	Presented final result to employees, researcher, and other interns with different disciplines.
	Experimented with Wireshark to see how data packages are coded.

positions.title: Student Trainee
positions.description:
	Computerized recordkeeping, Applications, Departmental Administration. 
	Implemented  payroll for ten employees, recordkeeping, equipment usage, and material receipt.
	Reviewed land appraisals and analysis in Montgomery county and Elmore County.
	Performed light clerical duties, improved the companies obsolete filing system by developing a simple but sophisticated functional system.
